$schema.description: Points editors at the generated JSON Schema, for autocomplete.

asset.description: Placed assets whose asset ID is this or starts with `<this>_` clean the air.

radius_m.description: How far it cleans, in metres. Its cleaning falls smoothly to 0 at this distance.

stops_when_harvested.description: Harvested assets (cut reeds) stop cleaning until they regrow.

strength.description: How strongly it cleans at its centre at full life, 0..1.

AirFollows.description: What part of an asset's life its cleaning follows.

oneOf.description: How grown it is (a tree from dormant to full bloom).
How green it is: the better of the water and light around it (reeds).
The light around it (desert brush blooms where the air is already clean).
